questions.text:
Consider the following Python code: def count(child_dict, i): 
    if i not in child_dict.keys(): 
         return 1 
    ans = 1 
    for j in child_dict[i]: 
        ans += count(child_dict, j) 
    return ans 
 
child_dict = dict() 
child_dict[0] = [1,2] 
child_dict[1] = [3,4,5]
